name: Remotasks
work: Image and video labelling, LiDAR annotation, copywriting and AI training tasks.

source.title: Rest of World: Scale AI's Remotasks cut off workers (2024)

availability.note: Remotasks shut down entirely in Kenya and Nigeria in March 2024. It publishes no list of where it still operates, so every other African country is unclear.

items.text: Remotasks shut down in Kenya, Nigeria and Pakistan in early 2024 and stopped new sign-ups in some other countries.
Kenyan users were told operations ended on 8 March 2024 and were off-boarded from their projects, with a promise that completed work would be paid.
Scale AI said the notice meant for Kenyan workers was not received because of operational errors, so many were cut off without warning.
In 2024 Remotasks paid per accepted task through PayPal, weekly on Thursdays.
Some websites still list Remotasks as open to Kenya and Nigeria. That information is out of date.
Anyone selling Remotasks access in Kenya or Nigeria is selling something the platform does not offer there.
